arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test auto-detection with i format
tests = [
    ('{:i}', '255', 255),
    ('{:i}', '-255', -255),
    ('{:i}', '+255', 255),
    ('{:i}', '0xFF', 255),
    ('{:i}', '-0xFF', -255),
    ('{:i}', '0b101', 5),
    ('{:i}', '-0b101', -5),
    ('{:i}', '0o77', 63),
    ('{:i}', '-0o77', -63),
]

for fmt, text, expected in tests:
    result = parse.parse(f'a {fmt} b', f'a {text} b')
    if result and result.fixed[0] == expected:
        print(f'OK: {fmt!r} with {text!r} -> {result.fixed[0]} (expected {expected})')
    elif result:
        print(f'FAIL: {fmt!r} with {text!r} -> {result.fixed[0]} (expected {expected})')
    else:
        print(f'FAIL: {fmt!r} with {text!r} -> NO MATCH')
"
